notes.title: Update 1.0.3 (NEW! Boost blocks, new map, more!)
notes.content:
Here are the new boost blocks, new map, improvements, fixes and adjustments in this update:


[b]Update 1.0.3 (3/19/2025)[/b]

* NEW  Added boosts blocks which gives player random buffs on collect

* NEW  Added Asian Town map

* NEW  Added hit animations to player

* NEW  Added health bar to player

* NEW  Doubled melee damage radius

* NEW  Increased network priority of character and ball

* NEW  Decreased UltiJump distances

* Fixed the ball from stucking in air sometimes when UltiKick used

* Fixed effect of UltiKick doesn't get destroyed if hit the ground first

* Fixed overlapping ball from upper goal and scoring doesn't detach ball

* Fixed player nickname on chat returns none if alphabet is different

* Fixed more minor bugs

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 (New content)
notes.content:
First update upon release is here! New gameplay content, improvements, and few bug fixes. New updates will come soon!


[b](Update 1.0.2 / 2/28/2025)[/b]

* NEW  Improved main menu, stats, settings, server browser UI

* NEW  Added achievements menu, controls menu UI

* NEW  Replaced running animation, reduced running speed by %10

* NEW  Added two different movement modes

* NEW  Added goalkeeper style ball blocking mechanic

* NEW  Added hit effect to goalkeeper

* NEW  Added dynamic camera shakes on movement

* NEW  Reduced the speed of rocket and eagle UltiShots by %25

* Fixed being stuck sometimes until next round when died

* Fixed opening and closing skill menu enables input while disabled

* Fixed host starting text when joined a started match

* Fixed holding down while striking animation doesn't reset kick strength

* Reduced velocity to overlap incoming ball (ball needs to be travel slower to catch)
